title: feat(lan): Terminal↔Terminal direct with protected outbound stage
body:
## Summary
- Adds Unix Terminal↔Terminal LAN direct (Noise/RLB1 dial, raven-node listener, ash send path) with durable ChatHistory and a protected outbound body stage.
- Stage is fail-closed on capacity, migrates legacy HISTORY-AAD `RVNOSTG1` and plaintext JSON safely (nlink/hardlink audited), and uses domain-separated AAD (`raven/outbound-stage/v1`).
- Capacity is reserved under an exclusive stage lock only until stage succeeds (released before `ipc_lan_dial`); orphaned Prepared outboxes are abandoned by exact session/digest/mid binding.

## Scope / verification
- Independent review green for this Unix LAN slice: raven-core 240, Ash 17×2, raven-node 14, clippy `-D warnings`, fmt, `lan_direct_two_node` smoke, both diff-checks; commit index was exactly 30 files (docs/`raven-security` left unstaged).
- **Not** claiming the full Windows / iPhone / NAT / Bridge / Offline matrix.

## Test plan
- [x] `cargo test -p raven-core -p ash -p raven-node`
- [x] `cargo clippy -p raven-core -p ash -p raven-node --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [x] `cargo fmt --check`
- [x] `bash node/scripts/lan_direct_two_node.sh`
- [ ] CI on PR
- [ ] Optional follow-up: Windows/iPhone/NAT/Bridge/Offline matrix

title: Open-source serverless audit surface (RVN1 / ATSAM / ash)
body:
## Summary
- Publishes the essential open-source audit surface on a reviewable branch: `protocol/` (RVN1/ATSAM specs + errata), `shared-vectors/`, Rust `node/` (`raven-core`, `raven-node`, `ash`, `raven-swarm`), and iOS `Core/Protocol` + `Core/Security` (+ related mesh/tests).
- Documents lab-only unlock via `RAVEN_LAB_TEST_A=1` (debug) and **fail-closed** production defaults; README no longer overclaims serverless DMs as production-complete.
- Hardens `.gitignore` for `node/target/`, proof artifacts, and local identity data; adds `ASSET_LICENSE.md` / `TRADEMARK.md` alongside existing AGPL-3.0.

## Included
- Protocol specs, Python reference codecs, deterministic vectors
- Serverless node/terminal implementation and CI workflow updates
- iOS protocol/crypto path and PairInit / indexed-session lab code (gated)
- Legacy FastAPI security maintenance patches that ship on this branch

## Excluded (intentionally not published)
- `.env` / credentials / deploy keys
- `~/.raven-ash` contacts, chat history, `identity.seed`
- `node/target/` build trees and proof-run artifact directories
- Internal secret-scan report churn; nested `raven-security` working tree noise

## Test plan
- [ ] `cd node && cargo test -p raven-core -p raven-node -p ash -p raven-swarm`
- [ ] Confirm GitHub Actions `raven-serverless` workflow runs on this PR
- [ ] Spot-check README lab-flag / fail-closed language
- [ ] Confirm no `.env`, `identity.seed`, or `node/target` files appear in the PR diff
